expected.finding: **[P2]** Preserve the full-archive coverage during rollback checks. In [revise-improvement-policy.py:555](/home/runner/work/open-inspect-72e95a/open-inspect-72e95a/scripts/revise-improvement-policy.py:555), `coverage` is overwritten with coverage from only the current policy’s rounds. Subsequent revision triggers and candidate acceptance compare this subset value against full-archive measurements. I reproduced both consequences: a policy covering 50% of the archive reports healthy thresholds because its own rounds have 100% coverage; a valid weight restoration is rejected as lowering coverage from 100% to 66.67%, although coverage is unchanged. Use a separate variable for the rollback comparison.
